text:
Jordan Park: hi all  new hire here, first-day checklist almost done but hit two cloud blocks: (1) GCP: project 'redwood-playground-2' shows "No billing account linked" so I can't enable the Cloud Build API. (2) AWS: after SSO I can list ECR but creating a repo errors with AccessDenied: ecr:CreateRepository.
Jordan Park: ran `aws sts get-caller-identity` and it shows assumed-role/Redwood-Developer/Jordan.
Maya Lin: welcome! for AWS that's an easy fix, cc'ing Riley from infra. Riley, can you check the dev role for ecr:CreateRepository?
Infra Bot: Hint: CI workflows sometimes require iam:PassRole alongside ecr permissions if a service role is used.
Riley Chan: added ecr:CreateRepository and iam:PassRole to the Redwood-Dev policy for your principal. Try `aws ecr create-repository --repository-name jordan-test`.
Jordan Park: create-repository succeeded 389 thanks Riley!
Maya Lin: for GCP billing, Finance links projects. Please file a request at https://access.redwood.com > New Request > Cloud Billing with the project id and your manager. If you paste the ticket id here I will ping Finance.
Jordan Park: filed INC-11300 (project redwood-playground-2, reason: onboarding dev work). Manager copied.
Finance Ops: INC-11300 received. Approving now; billing account link should be visible in ~30 minutes. You may need to re-login or run `gcloud auth login` after the link is created.
Jordan Park: billing linked and APIs enabled — all unblocked. Really appreciate the quick responses :thumbsup:
